payload.body_they: {{Name}}'s feelings tend to show before they have decided exactly what the feeling means. Their face changes, they get quieter, their attention shifts, or they need more space, and people close to them may notice before they have words for it. Their first emotional response is useful information, but it is not always the final answer. They usually do better when they have enough time to understand what they actually need before everybody else starts responding to the mood.
